meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

howto.what: 这个技能会引导你在已有的 AKS 集群上一步步搭建 AI Runway：检查集群、安装控制器、评估 GPU、选择推理提供商，最后部署第一个模型。每步都先向你确认再操作。
howto.when: 当你说到“setup AI Runway”“install AI Runway”“deploy model to AKS”等关键词，或要求配置 AI Runway、在 AKS 上跑模型时触发。

howto.what_en: Guides you step-by-step from an existing AKS cluster to a running AI model: verify cluster, install controller, assess GPUs, pick an inference provider, and deploy the first model. Confirms with you before each action.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "setup AI Runway", "install AI Runway", "deploy model to AKS", or ask to configure AI Runway or run models on AKS.
